terra.problem: The LORD instructs Moses to tell the people to ask their neighbors; the verses do not say that they actually ask.
The verses specify firstborn sons and the firstborn of the cattle, not every firstborn without qualification.
These are instructions, not a report that households select and keep the lambs. A household too small for a lamb is to share one with a neighbor.
The verses instruct the people to apply the blood and eat the lamb, and promise that the LORD will pass over them; they do not report these things as having happened.
